description: This file is a test script for Git's rev-list bitmap and filter functionalities, setting up a repository, applying various filters, and verifying traversal outputs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a description.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified message or content.

methods.name: git repack
methods.description: Repacks the repository to consolidate objects, with options for aggressive packing.

methods.name: git tag
methods.description: Creates a new tag pointing to the current HEAD.

methods.name: git hash-object
methods.description: Computes and writes the object ID of a given file or stdin input.

methods.name: git rev-list
methods.description: Outputs a list of revisions (commits) reachable from a given commit.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files or outputs to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_bitmap_traversal
methods.description: Verifies traversal outputs utilizing bitmaps in the repository.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
